IndiGo is planning to increase aircraft ownership from 20% to 30–40% by 2030, moving away from its long-standing asset-light model. But why change a strategy that helped the airline grow?
In this video, we explore:
PART 1: How the sale-and-leaseback model works and why IndiGo adopted it.
PART 2: Why IndiGo is shifting towards aircraft ownership and the challenges it faces.
Was sale and leaseback really the secret behind IndiGo’s success?
